_meta.purpose: Re-read the two meat-thermometer listings and one air-fryer listing from their official Amazon pages through the platform page-fetch tool (no login, one read per URL), to fill the fields F-60 left blank and to re-confirm the titles the site publishes. Only values the listing itself states are recorded. Prices and star ratings were seen on the pages and are NOT recorded (F-02).
_meta.method: Each listing was fetched and the following sections read where present: page title, category breadcrumb, the 'Purchase options and add-ons' Item-details table, the 'About this item' bullets, and any model notice. Values are copied as the listing words them; nothing is converted, averaged or inferred.
_meta.limitations: The fetch tool renders the page as text, so an element that only appears interactively cannot be confirmed. No account, no Associates Central session and no browser were available, so the Associates Central checks (F-57, F-58) were not performed.
